# Establish a channel or commercial partnership

[Overview](#overview) · [Before you start](#before-you-start) · [Steps](#steps-at-a-glance)

## Overview

When another organization may refer, resell, integrate or jointly deliver the company's product. An approved partnership agreement, tested operating handoffs and an owned performance review.

Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.

> This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.

> Editorial status: operational draft. Source pages checked on 2026-10-29. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance or completed execution is claimed.

## Step details

<a id="step-1"></a>

### 1. Define the partnership model and economics

agent-runnable


Describe the target customers, roles, referral or resale flow, economics and delivery dependencies. Separate a co-marketing arrangement from authority to sell, bind or represent the company.

- Sources: [GitLab retain and expand operating procedures](https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/sales/sales-operating-procedures/retain-and-expand/) · [SBA manage your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/manage-your-business/)

<a id="step-2"></a>

### 2. Review the partner and commercial risks

human · human approval required


Verify the counterparty and assess capability, conflicts, data sharing and market fit. Counsel reviews agency, competition, tax and local restrictions for the actual arrangement.

- Sources: [GitLab retain and expand operating procedures](https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/sales/sales-operating-procedures/retain-and-expand/) · [SBA manage your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/manage-your-business/)

<a id="step-3"></a>

### 3. Prepare the operating and agreement terms

agent-runnable


Draft lead ownership, customer support, payments, branding, data access, success measures and termination handoffs. Identify which responsibilities stay with the company and which the partner can perform.

- Sources: [GitLab retain and expand operating procedures](https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/sales/sales-operating-procedures/retain-and-expand/) · [SBA manage your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/manage-your-business/)

<a id="step-4"></a>

### 4. Approve the agreement and pilot

human · human approval required


Authorized parties execute the reviewed terms and approve a bounded initial test. Confirm training and access before enabling customer introductions or delegated selling rights.

- Sources: [GitLab retain and expand operating procedures](https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/sales/sales-operating-procedures/retain-and-expand/) · [SBA manage your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/manage-your-business/)

<a id="step-5"></a>

### 5. Review results and reconcile obligations

agent-runnable


Match leads, revenue, commissions and customer issues to the agreement. Resolve disputes through the named owners and decide whether to continue, revise or terminate with a controlled customer handover.

- Verify: An approved partnership agreement, tested operating handoffs and an owned performance review.
- Sources: [GitLab retain and expand operating procedures](https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/sales/sales-operating-procedures/retain-and-expand/) · [SBA manage your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/manage-your-business/)
